in_marathi.name: Parsu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parsu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'paras' which means 'to shoot, to reach' or 'to overcome'. In Hindu mythology, Parsu is the name of several gods and heroes associated with archery and victory.

in_bengali.name: Parsu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Parsu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'paras' which means 'to shoot, to reach' or 'to overcome'. In Hindu mythology, Parsu is the name of several gods and heroes associated with archery and victory.
